text_block_list.text:
Just a little more until first place-- I 
was so close!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
A! Stellar! Effort! You did great, 
Tsuyoshi!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Just a little short of first place! I'll 
definitely win next time, just you 
wait--!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Right?! That's what I thought too! It was 
a great run that almost took 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If I can keep getting stronger like 
this... Hehehe! I can only see a future 
where I win!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, we're gonna climb up the 
placings non-stop!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I know. Even right now, everyone I've 
raced against is getting stronger too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I have to work even 
harder to surpass that!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to cross the finish line in 
1st place in our next race!
